meta.title: For Employees — NestSelf
meta.description: Access therapy, legal and financial support through your employer. Confidential, free where your employer covers it, and available in Serbian, Hungarian and English.

hero.title: Support that stays between you and your professional
hero.lead: If your employer offers NestSelf, you can talk to a licensed psychologist, get legal guidance or work through a financial question — all confidential. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

photo.alt: Employee relaxing on a break with a cup of tea

items.title: Therapy & Counselling
items.body: Talk to a licensed psychologist or qualified psychotherapist — online or in person. Individual, couples and family sessions are available.

items.title: Legal Consultation
items.body: Get confidential guidance on personal legal matters — family law, tenancy, consumer rights.

items.title: Financial Guidance
items.body: Work through budgeting, debt, savings or retirement questions with a certified financial professional.

items.title: Wellbeing check-ins
items.body: Short, validated questionnaires that help you understand your wellbeing and find the right support — not a diagnosis.

items.title: Webinars
items.body: Live and on-demand expert sessions on stress, parenting, finances and more.

items.title: Resources
items.body: Articles, guides and self-help tools you can explore any time.

photo.alt: A person sitting on a sofa completing a wellbeing check-in

steps.title: Check your access
steps.body: Your employer will let you know when NestSelf is available. You can also ask your HR team or check with us.

steps.title: Create your private account
steps.body: Sign up with the link or code your employer shares. Your account is yours alone.

steps.title: Browse or book
steps.body: Explore resources, take a wellbeing check-in or book a session with a professional.

steps.title: Talk to a professional
steps.body: Meet your psychologist, legal professional or financial consultant online or in person. Everything you discuss is confidential.

whoSeesWhat.title: Who sees what
paragraphs: Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees anonymised usage for groups of 10 or more — never individual names, session content or assessment results.
All professionals are bound by professional secrecy. Your data is processed under GDPR and local data protection law.
bullets: Your employer never sees your name, sessions or results
Anonymised reports require a minimum group of 10
Professionals are bound by professional secrecy

forYourFamily.title: For your family
paragraphs: Where your employer's plan includes family members, your partner and children can access the same therapy, legal and financial support — at no extra cost to you.

items.question: Is it really free for me?
items.answer: Free for you where your employer covers it. Your coverage is shown before you confirm anything.

items.question: Does my employer know I use it?
items.answer: No. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees anonymised usage for groups of 10 or more.

items.question: What can I use it for?
items.answer: Therapy and counselling, legal consultation, financial guidance, wellbeing check-ins, webinars and resources — depending on your employer's plan.

items.question: Can my family use it?
items.answer: Where your employer's plan includes family members, your partner and children access the same services at no extra cost.

items.question: How do I book a session?
items.answer: Log in to your NestSelf workspace, choose the type of support you need and pick a time that works for you.

items.question: What if I need help right now?
items.answer: If you are in immediate danger, call the emergency number now: 112 (Serbia and Hungary). For an ambulance: 194 (Serbia) or 104 (Hungary). For crisis support: Centar Srce 0800 300 303 (Serbia), Lelki Elsősegély Telefonszolgálat 116 123 (Hungary).

items.question: Are the professionals licensed?
items.answer: Yes. Our network includes licensed psychologists, qualified psychotherapists, legal professionals and certified financial consultants.

items.question: What happens to my data?
items.answer: Your data is processed under GDPR and local data protection law. Professionals are bound by professional secrecy. Your employer never sees individual data.

cta.body: If your employer offers NestSelf, open the workspace to browse resources, take a check-in or book a session.
